name: dreamy-vintage-boudoir-blonde
image_purpose: vintage fashion lookbook and editorial portrait

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic vintage-inspired bedroom portrait of one original approved adult woman seated in a pink velvet chair, preserving the pastel styling and cinematic texture.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with two thick loose blonde braids, curtain bangs, dewy realistic skin, soft peach makeup, and an ethereal expression. She wears a sage-green bandeau top with matching high-waisted briefs, styled as a tasteful coordinated fashion set, with gold rings and a purple hardcover book titled 'Written in the Stars' by Brianna Priest.
composition_elements: Low-angle seated portrait in a pink velvet armchair, torso angled slightly toward camera.
Left arm draped over the chair back; right hand holds the book near shoulder.
Soft pink walls, floral curtains, pastel dressing-room details, and no water.
Keep the book cover wording as supplied and avoid adding unrelated text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused indoor light with warm rosy glow, subtle rim light, pastel dusty-rose and sage palette, dreamy cinematic mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm prime lens, f/2.8, ultra-photorealistic RAW look, 8K detail, realistic skin and textile texture, Hasselblad-inspired photography, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic vintage-inspired bedroom portrait of an original approved adult woman with two thick loose blonde braids over the shoulders, soft curtain bangs, dewy realistic skin with visible pores, soft peach makeup and an ethereal expression. She sits gracefully in a pink velvet chair, leaning slightly forward with her torso angled toward camera, left arm over the chair back and right hand holding the book near her shoulder.
